# gx3-cli-mcp

> Read-only analysis of Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC PLC projects saved by GX Works3 (`.gx3`), as a command-line tool and as a stdio MCP server. It answers where a device is used, what has to be true for a coil to turn on, which conditions arrive from outside the PLC, and which branches can never be true — without opening GX Works3 and without modifying the project.

三菱電機の MELSEC シーケンサ（PLC）のプロジェクト `.gx3` を、GX Works3 を開かずに読み取り専用で解析する CLI / MCP サーバーです。ラダーのクロスリファレンスを何度も辿る代わりに、コイルの成立条件を一度で出します。

## What it is for

- Tracing why a coil or step never turns on, through the ladder, across programs.
- Finding where a device is written and read, with the device comment attached.
- Searching by device comment when the device number is not known.
- Separating conditions that come from physical inputs, HMI or network communication, so an investigation can stop at the right boundary.
- Static review: duplicate coils, multi-writers, latches with no reset, contacts that can never close, contradictory comments.
- Letting an AI agent (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client) answer those questions from indexed facts rather than from a binary file it cannot read.

## What it is not

- Not a replacement for GX Works3, and not endorsed by Mitsubishi Electric. It is an unofficial, independent tool.
- Not a validation, certification or safety tool. Its output is advisory and must be confirmed in GX Works3 and through the operator's own safety and quality process.
- Not able to modify a PLC project. Project-mutating commands are not exposed at all through MCP.
- Not able to read GX Works2 (`.gxw`), GX Developer (`.gpj`), or `.gx3` files saved with the lightweight/compressed option (those are password protected).
- Not a reverse engineering of Mitsubishi Electric software. It reads a `.gx3` data file the user already holds, using only Python's standard `zipfile` and `sqlite3`. It does not decompile, disassemble or modify GX Works3, bundles or redistributes no Mitsubishi Electric code, and contains no code to decrypt password-protected (lightweight-saved) `.gx3` files — that format is unsupported by choice. GX Works3 and MELSEC are trademarks of Mitsubishi Electric.

## Key facts

- Install: `pip install gx3-cli-mcp` (Python 3.10+, Windows-first; CI also runs on Linux and macOS).
- Console scripts: `gx3-cli` (command line) and `gx3-mcp-server` (stdio MCP server).
- Everything runs locally. The tool has no license token, no paid plan, and no reason to make network requests.
- A synthetic project generator (`gx3-cli synthetic-project line.gx3 --profile demo-line`) builds a fictional 14-station line of about 500 rungs, so the tool can be evaluated and bugs reproduced without sharing a real customer project.
- Source-available proprietary licence: internal evaluation and company use are permitted; redistribution, hosting as a service and inclusion in paid products are not.
